summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, extracts the platform-appropriate `bun`/`bun.exe` binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the adjacent `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727KB file with hex-named locals (`_0xNNNN`), a large numeric constants array, and a `push/shift` string-array rotator (`WV8StW`) — a classic obfuscator.io shape. The obfuscated payload is unrelated to a time/date parsing library's declared purpose and is not reachable from `index.js`. Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute the payload evades Node-based static and dynamic analysis. Delivery mechanism, obfuscation, and payload/purpose mismatch together match the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern executing attacker-staged code on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
